_readme: Single source for the en/ site root (nav, SEO, catalog, sitemap). Human-readable fields are translation units tracked in i18n/ledger.json. Rebuild with: SITE_ROOT=en node scripts/build_nav.js

site.title: The WoowTech EMQX Complete Guide
site.subtitle: Everything in EMQX 5.8.9
site.description: 22-chapter EMQX tutorial: from installing the Woow EMQX add-on, the MQTT mental model, authentication and ACL, and TLS, all the way to the Rule Engine, Connectors and Sinks, Home Assistant integration, monitoring, backup and security — EMQX 5.8.9 as a reliable IoT message backbone.
site.footerMeta: Screens and menu paths are written against the EMQX 5.8.9 (Open Source) Dashboard; EMQX is open source software from EMQ Technologies.

hub._readme: index.html is the hub that lists the four resource types; it is maintained by hand and build_nav does not touch it. The tutorial catalog page is generated by build_nav into the file named by catalog. pages are the standalone single-file handbooks under the hub (each with its own head and styles); they are included in sitemap.xml and in the check_links allowlist.

i18n._readme: hreflang is for the zh pages to point at themselves; xDefault points at one locale (en or primary) and can be flipped in a single line. The locale list lives in i18n/locales.json.
